VICTORY: 1 sword lowered at side; 2 rests gauntlet on sheath; 3 straightens torso with head tilted; 4 calm vigilant cyborg stance.
DEFEAT: 1 staggers on mechanical legs; 2 drops one knee holding sword low; 3 sits exhausted with blade flat nearby inside cell; 4 non-graphic side slump with intact limbs.
